title: Microscopic mechanism for resonant light-enhanced pair correlations in K$_3$C$_{60}$
summary: Recent experiments on K3C60 revealed a giant enhancement of the light-induced superconducting-like optical response for pump frequencies near 10 THz, with an efficiency roughly two orders of magnitude larger than for off resonant excitation. Here we show that a resonant enhancement of pair correlations arises naturally in a driven purely electronic model of K$_3$C$_{60}$ with ab initio parameters.
